Ingredients
1 kilogram rump steak (beef)
150 grams rashers bacon
500 grams potatoes (peeled)
1 medium onion
1 garlic clove
6 peppercorns
1 bay leaf
1 tsp parsley
4 tbsp flour
1⁄2 liter red wine
1⁄2 liter beef stock (bouillon)
3 tbsp tomato puree
3 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
A dash of lemon juice
How To
Cook the bacon until crispy. Drain on paper towels and set aside.
Cut the meat into pieces. Brown the meat on all sides in a heavy pan. Remove and set aside.
Remove all but 1 tbsp of the bacon fat from the pan and add the onions, garlic, peppercorns, bay leaf, parsley and flour. Cook on low heat for about 5 minutes.
Add the wine, stock, tomato puree, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice. Simmer for about 5 minutes.

Slow Cooker Chicken Tortilla Soup

1 (15-ounce) can black beans, drained and rinsed

1 teaspoon salt

1/2 cup sour cream

output: A home equity loan is a type of loan that allows you to borrow money against the equity in your home.  Equity is the difference between the market value of your home and the amount you still owe on your mortgage.  So if your home is worth $200,000 and you owe $100,000 on your mortgage, then you have $100,000 in equity.  A home equity loan allows you to borrow up to 80% of your home’s equity, which means you could borrow up to $80,000.  The loan is secured by your home, so if you don’t make your payments, the lender can foreclose on your home.  Home equity loans are typically used for large purchases like home renovations or paying off high-interest debt.

1 cup brown lentils
2 cups water
1 teaspoon salt

1 large onion, chopped

1 teaspoon cumin
1 teaspoon paprika
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
1/4 teaspoon cinnamon
1/4 teaspoon allspice

1/4 teaspoon ground ginger

3.  Add the cooked lentils and rice to the skillet.  Stir well to combine, then add the parsley and stir again.  Cook for another 5 minutes, or until the rice is tender.  Serve hot.

1. Choose the right time of year:  Plants are most likely to survive when they’re moved in the spring or fall, when temperatures are mild and there’s plenty of moisture in the air.  Avoid moving plants during the hottest or coldest months of the year, as this can stress them out and make them more susceptible to disease.
2. Prepare the new garden bed:  Before you move your plant, make sure the new garden bed is ready for it.  This means removing any weeds or debris, adding organic matter like compost or manure, and tilling the soil to a depth of at least 6 inches.  This will give the plant plenty of space to grow and will also help it to absorb nutrients from the soil.
3. Water the plant well:  Before you move the plant, water it thoroughly so that it’s well hydrated.  This will help it to survive the move and will also reduce the risk of shock.
4. Move the plant carefully:  Use a trowel or shovel to carefully lift the plant out of its pot and place it in the new garden bed.  Be sure to keep the roots intact, as this will help the plant to establish itself in its new home.
5. Water the plant again:  Once the plant is in its new home, water it again to help it settle in and adjust to its new environment.

Ingredients:
• 1 lb beef chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes
• 1 large onion, chopped
• 2 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 cup carrots, sliced
• 1 cup potatoes, peeled and cubed
• 2 cups water
• 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
• 1/2 teaspoon salt
• 1/4 teaspoon black pepper
• 1 bay leaf
• 1/2 cup tomato sauce
• 1/2 cup coconut milk
Instructions:
1. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides. Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
2. Add the onions and garlic to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add the carrots and potatoes and cook for another 5 minutes.
3. Add the water, salt, pepper, bay leaf, tomato sauce, and coconut milk to the pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour, or until the beef is tender.
4. Return the beef to the pot and cook for another 15 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
5. Serve the pochero with rice and enjoy!”

Swordfish a la Siciliana
Ingredients:
1 pound swordfish steaks (alternately, use tuna steaks or chicken cutlets)
1/4 cup extra-virgin olive oil
1/4 cup red wine vinegar
1/4 cup fresh-squeezed lemon juice
3 cloves garlic, finely chopped
1/2 cup fresh flat-leaf parsley, finely chopped
1 teaspoon fresh oregano
1 teaspoon crushed red chili flakes
3/4 cup plain bread crumbs (high-quality, fresh bread crumbs will work best; if they’re very dry, add 1 tablespoon water to the crumbs to help them stick to the fish)
salt and freshly ground pepper

8. Place the swordfish on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 375°F for 15 minutes.
9. Once the fish is cooked through, remove it from the oven and cover with the remaining bread crumb mixture.
10. Return it to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
11. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving, with lemon wedges on the side for garnish. USER: Would it be possible to pan fry the swordfish instead of baking?

Bitcoin is also unique in that it is not backed by any government or central bank. Instead, it relies on the trust of its users to maintain its value. Ingredients:
1 cup chickpeas, soaked overnight
1 cup long-grain white rice
2 teaspoons ghee or oil
1 teaspoon cumin seeds
1 teaspoon coriander seeds
1 teaspoon garam masala
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon red chili powder
1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
1/4 teaspoon black pepper powder
1/4 cup chopped onions
1/4 cup chopped tomatoes

4. Add the green chilies, coriander leaves, and mint leaves and cook for another 5 minutes.
5. Add the rice and stir to coat the rice with the spices. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the rice is tender.

1/2 cup white sugar
2 eggs

1 teaspoon baking soda
1 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 teaspoon salt

Ingredients:
- 1 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes
- 1 cup mushrooms, sliced
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
- 1/2 cup chicken broth
- 1/2 cup milk
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/4 teaspoon pepper
- 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed
- 1 egg, beaten

Instructions:
1.  Preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
2.  In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.  Add the mushrooms and cook until they are tender, about 5 minutes.  Remove from heat and set aside.
3.  In a medium bowl, combine the flour, chicken broth, milk, salt, and pepper.  Whisk until smooth.
4.  Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.  Stir in the mushroom mixture and cook for another 2 minutes.
5.  Transfer the chicken mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.  Unfold the puff pastry sheet and place it over the chicken mixture.  Press the edges of the pastry down to seal it around the edges of the dish.
6.  Using a sharp knife, cut several slits in the top of the pastry to allow steam to escape.
7.  Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.  Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.

These materials are usually made of gallium arsenide, which is a semiconductor that emits light when electricity flows through it.
